technical.summary: ABBV shows bullish structure (price above key EMAs, supertrend, OBV rising) but lacks trend confirmation (low ADX), momentum divergence (AO negative, CMF negative), and elevated stochastic levels suggest caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 46 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (1 small buy vs 2 sales) with no composite signal; fear sentiment (40) presents potential contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and weak conviction limit actionability.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (83.1) indicates extreme fear, strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, CPI event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 46 days present binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend bullish and OBV rising provides structural upside bias, supported by fear-zone sentiment offering contrarian opportunity near support level 134.59.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 83.1, strong dollar), momentum divergence (negative AO/CMF), overbought stochastic (78.82), weak ADX trend confirmation, and earnings binary risk in 46 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Price at support (134.59) with bullish technical structure (above 200-EMA, supertrend, OBV) offers contrarian entry in fear zone. However, macro headwinds and momentum divergence create asymmetric risk that does not justify new exposure.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (83.1), inverted yield curve, and earnings binary in 46 days create severe downside tail risk; negative momentum (AO, CMF) and overbought stochastic (78.82) suggest pullback likely before any sustained rally.
decision.recommended_exit: N/A — skip entry; if forced to trade: atr_trail_1x with tight stop at 132.50 (below support).
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical structure insufficient to overcome macro/fundamental headwinds.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ABBV with 15 open Health Care positions (23% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; macro environment argues for sector rotation, not addition.
